messages:
robin: Need a 1-pager quickcard for Enterprise compliance teams. Focus: finance & regulated verticals, call out SLA bands, data residency, and an abridged benchmark. Also include an inbound routing rule + two email subject templates for SDRs.

jess: I can do layout. Suggest sections: hero statement, 3 security bullets (encryption, residency, audit), SLA table (Bronze/Silver/Gold), deployment callouts (hosted/dedicated/private), benchmark highlights, and two CTAs.

arjun: For security bullets add explicit language: "bring-your-own-key (BYOK) support" and "optional HSM for FIPS-compliant key storage". Mention SOC2 + ISO27001 where applicable.

maya: SLA table draft: Bronze = 99.5% uptime, Silver = 99.9%, Gold = 99.95% with p99 latency targets of 300ms/150ms/100ms respectively. Call out available financial credits for missed SLOs.

ben: Benchmark bullets (conservative): 1) ded pool gen workload p50=35ms, p95=120ms; 2) caching reduces repeated-prefix token spend ~40%; 3) batching increases throughput x3 for medium-sized prompts. Add note: results vary by model.

jess: Two headlines for quickcard: 1) "Compliance-ready inference for finance and regulated teams" 2) "Secure, auditable LLM serving with SLA guarantees" 1 vote per person in thread pls.

arjun: Vote 2. Cleaner/legal-forward.

robin: Routing rules we need: automatically tag and escalate inbound trial requests from regulated industries and high-volume prospects. Example pseudo-rule (copyable):
```
if lead.industry in ["finance","healthcare","government"] or lead.tags contains "compliance":
  lead.priority = "high"
  assign.queue = "enterprise-sdr"
  notify.channel = "#sdr-enterprise"
  lead.tag_add(["enterprise","compliance"])
  if lead.estimated_monthly_tokens > 5e6:
    escalate_to = "solutions-architect"
```

maya: Also include an email subject template for SDR outreach: "[Company] + Redwood: Secure LLM serving for regulated workflows" and a shorter option for cold outreach: "Secure LLM inference for [Company]"

ben: Add a demo webhook example for product demos: `POST /api/v1/demo-request` body: `{"company":"Acme","use_case":"fraud-detection","compliance":"SOC2,PCI","expected_tokens_per_month":8000000}`.

jess: I'll assemble copy and pass to design. robin, can you confirm residency phrasing? We should allow EU-only and US-only tenancy options.

robin: Confirmed: include "data residency: regional control planes, option for EU-only or US-only model hosting, and export controls guidance."

pipeline-bot: draft_saved: https://drive.company/redwood/marketing/compliance-quickcard-draft (perm: marketing-edit) :white_check_mark:

arjun: Quick sales one-liner for AE card: "Run LLM features with enterprise SLAs, BYOK/HSM options, and regional hosting for compliance-sensitive apps."

robin: Final asks: jess to lock headlines+copy by EOD, ben to verify benchmark numbers with infra, maya to map SLA legal language with legal. Plan webinar snippet: 15 min product + 15 min compliance Q&A. We'll route registrants using the rule above. Thanks all.
